sources.title: BLIP - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapped Language-Image Pretraining) is a vision-language pretraining (VLP) framework designed for both understanding and generation tasks. Most existing pretrained models are only good at one or the other. It uses a captioner to generate captions and a filter to remove the noisy captions.
